mcq.QUESTION_DESC: Why is polymorphism considered an important feature in object-oriented programming?

sq.ANSWER:
Polymorphism in Java refers to the ability of an object to take on many forms. The two main types are:
Compile-time polymorphism (achieved through method overloading)
Runtime polymorphism (achieved through method overriding)
